Scope: roads and paving, potable water, TSE, sewer, storm water, irrigation and landscaping, electrical (medium voltage, telecom, street lighting) and CCTV networks in Zones A and G, over 18 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. On 19-Oct-2026 the project is 45.4% complete against 40.7% planned, 4.8% ahead (SPI 1.12). This week it gained 0.64% against 1.56% planned, so the lead narrowed from 5.7% to 4.8%. Road works and the storm and sewer networks are ahead; procurement and engineering are behind.

Ahead overall, but the lead is shrinking and procurement is behind. This week's progress (0.64%) was well under the weekly plan (1.56%). Procurement is at 60.1% against 99.2% planned (SPI 0.61): MV cables (0 of 51,500 m), unit substations, street lighting poles and lighting panels are not yet delivered, and the final substation location is still pending between the Client and SEC. The P6 update finishes the project on the contract date, 05-Jul-2027, with zero float.

Data notes

  • The uploaded files name the project "Phase Two – Part Two" (SUD1-02-011), while the repository folder and the project tracker call it Phase 3 (المرحلة الثالثة).
  • The summary sheet labels cost-based progress as "Plan" and "Actual". This report uses physical progress (man-hour weighted) only: 40.66% planned and 45.43% actual.
  • The Physical-Chart Data sheet plans 44.2% at its October point (06-Oct), more than the 40.66% planned to 19-Oct on the front sheet, and it shows the 19-Oct actual (45.43%) on the 06-Oct point.
  • The front sheet leaves physical progress for electrical, landscape and CCTV works blank; the man-hours in the Progress sheet were used. Its BOQ values for CCTV Zone A and Zone G read 46,056 and 2 SAR instead of 6,513,996 and 2,791,854.
  • Activity counts differ: the P6 update has 787 completed, 300 in progress and 1,028 not started; the schedule panel of the weekly report has 711, 352 and 1,052 (the front sheet shows 144 in progress).
  • The weekly report puts the procurement phase baseline at 23-Jan-2027; the approved baseline schedule has 21-Nov-2026.
  • The summary page's scope table shows 0 executed for every network, and its totals differ from the hidden Conclusion sheet (for example roads 15,234 m vs 18,252 m). Manholes are labelled "m" in the Major Quantities sheet but are counted in units.
  • Procurement figures disagree: street lighting poles are 590 units and 10% complete in the Procurement sheet but 592 units with 1 delivered in Major Quantities; LV cables are 29,700 m vs 68,400 m. MV cables are "not submitted" in procurement, while the risk register says they have been procured.
  • October planned head count is 355 in the monthly table (327 manual, 28 non-manual) but 335 in the head-count panel (300 manual, 35 non-manual).
  • Several cells show #REF! errors (EAC, risk scores, safety score in the status score). The substation risk carries a value of 6,835,460.61 SAR, which is the landscape BOQ value.
  • Only the 19-Oct-2026 report was used. Weekly gains for earlier weeks and this-week quantities are not stated in it, so they show "–". The report week is the contract week the report states (41 of 78); whole weeks since handover give 40.
